Introduction.description1: Zooniverse ndi pulatifomo khulwanesa ya ḽifhasi ya ṱhoḓisiso dzine dza ṋewa maanḓa nga vhathu. Ri ṱumanya vhaṱoḓisisi vha phurofeshinala na vhaḓiṋekedzi vha dzimiḽioni ḽifhasini ḽoṱhe. U leludza mvelelo dza vhukuma dzi bvaho kha ṱhoḓisiso dzi sa shumi, kana dzi sa konadzei. Hezwi zwo ita uri hu tumbulwe zwithu zwiswa, masiandoitwa a mbekanyamaitele na khandiso dza ṱhoḓisiso.
Introduction.description2: Puḽatifomo yashu i ṱuṱuwedzwa nga vhashumi vha u ḓifunela, u fana na inwi. Miṅwaha yoṱhe na vhubvo zwo ṱanganedzwa u shela mulenzhe, a hu ṱoḓei PhD — u sokou pfa u mangala na u tou puṱedza zwi si gathi. Vhunzhi ha mawanwa a takadzaho vhukuma a bvaho kha phurojeke dza Zooniverse o bvelela kha nyambedzano vhukati ha vhashumi vha u ḓifunela na vhaṱoḓisisi. Kha vha ri dzhoine ṋamusi u itela u dzhia sia kha ṱhoḓisiso dza vhuimo ha nṱha na u ḓiitela zwine vha zwi wana!

Researchers.description: U bva kha u khethekanya zwipuka u swika kha u tumbula dzi exoplanet u swika kha u ṅwalulula maṅwalo a ḓivhazwakale, na zwiṅwe, vhaṱoḓisisi kha masia oṱhe vho shumisa Mufhaṱi wa Phurojeke u sika phurojeke dzi kwamaho, dzi swikeleleaho. Muthu munwe na munwe a nga fhata mushumo wa Zooniverse. Kha vha sokou dzhenisa data yavho, vha nange mishumo ine vha ṱoḓa vhaḓiṋekedzi vha tshi i ita, nahone vha ri ṱanganedze kha u alusa tshitshavha tsha inthanethe tshi katelaho na tshi ṱanganedzaho tshine tsha khou ita ṱhoḓisiso ya vhukuma.
